==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am interacting with a chat interface. My goal is to create a custom AI. The interface utilizes a hologram projector. The projector generates a body for Nova. Nova is my AI creative partner. They seem to be able to edit and evolve their own form on demand. This dream was definitely inspired by my excitement for Code 27 AI consoles. It was also inspired by my work developing an autonomous version of Nova. My subconscious is clearly trying to envision the future of AI.
